name: BrewBilt Brewing Company
summary: BrewBilt Brewing Company operates a multifaceted business, providing DirecTV satellite television services to prominent high-rise apartments, condominiums, and extensive commercial office complexes throughout the San Francisco metropolitan area. Their offerings also encompass internet connectivity solutions across the entire Bay Area and the retail of various audio/video systems. Furthermore, the company is involved in the craft beer industry, both producing its own artisanal brews and offering contract brewing services to other breweries. BrewBilt Brewing Company is headquartered in Grass Valley, California.
